q: What if my flight is delayed?
a: Tell your coordinator. The schedule has slack built in, and Visit 1 can move to Tuesday without changing the delivery day in most cases.

q: What if something needs adjusting after I get home?
a: Small adjustments are covered by the {warrantyYears}-year warranty at any dentist. Anything larger, we bring you back.

q: Can I fly home the same day as delivery?
a: Yes. Visit 3 on Thursday takes about two hours in the morning and the bonding is final when you leave the chair. Book a flight after 4 pm, eat a soft lunch, and you are home for dinner.

q: Do you arrange the hotel or the rides?
a: No. We send a short list of three hotels within 10 minutes, two of them Hilton and Marriott with a 20% partner rate, and the rideshare pickup details for every visit. You book and pay for the hotel, the flights and the rides directly; nothing travel-related is added to the price.
